samples.question: At the top a key has four rows; each row shows a coloured dot on the left and a shape on the right, so the key pairs colours with shapes.  Below are two columns of four slots: every left slot shows one coloured dot, every right slot shows one shape, and every slot has a marker below it that is either a filled dark square or an open square.  Bind each left slot to the right slot whose shape the key pairs with that slot's colour. A pair is TRUE when the two bound slots show the same marker kind.  How many true pairs are there: zero, one, two, three, or four?
